THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 07
Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: LD/05/2007/MV/108F.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.

Description of land to be acquired: The allotments of land described below in the Topographic Preliminary Plan No. 20, Supplementary Plan No. 107, Sheet No. 178 approved by the Surveyor General dated 31st October, 2013 situated a Kambarawa village, Kambarawa Grama Niladhari Division in Gangala Pallesiya Pattuwa of Naula Divisional Secretary’s Division, Matale District, Central Province.
